title: Large video uploads and clearer paste feedback
summary: The chat upload limit is aligned with the server, and unavailable clipboard attachments now get clear feedback. A new PWA keyboard experiment is available in Feedback.

sections.heading: Video upload reliability
items: Chat accepts supported attachments up to 64 MiB. The server limit now matches the app.
Pins discussions keep their separate 50 MiB attachment limit.
Failed uploads keep their preview and draft for retry, with readable error feedback.

sections.heading: Paste feedback
items: Pasted video files still stage for review when the browser supplies them.
If a paste event provides no usable attachment, the composer points you to the attachment picker.
Text paste and your staged media continue to use the regular Send button.

sections.heading: PWA keyboard investigation
items: Settings > Feedback > Open keyboard comparison now includes a System text dialog test.
This tests a different text-entry route; removal of Apple's toolbar is not yet verified.
Tap Restart Now to load this update.
